content.text: You're a digital creator in Nigeria, unable to collect [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/top-7-options-selling-digital-downloads-pakistan-ranked|COREMERCH guide to options]]-ethiopian-digital-creators-first-principles-definitive|Payment Options]]-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-which-architecture-actually|payment]] through conventional platforms like Stripe. You're not alone – many others in Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines face the same issue. This is not a problem of choice, but a reality of platform restrictions. It's time to break free and deploy your digital store on your own terms, with infrastructure that you own and control.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Stack 01 — the Sovereign Starter Stack — uses GitHub Pages for storefront hosting, Google Apps Script as the backend Web App, Google Sheets as the order database, Google Drive for product file storage, and Gmail for delivery email. The entire stack costs nothing per month. Google Apps Script runs in response to webhook events from NOWPayments, validates the payment, logs the order to Google Sheets, generates a receipt, and sends a Gmail delivery email with a Google Drive shared link. The daily limits on the free tier are adequate for most creators at the early and growth stages.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your digital store, you'll need to set up a GitHub account, create a GitHub Pages site, and generate a Supabase project. Additionally, you'll need to create a NOWPayments account and configure it to accept crypto payments. Don't worry if you're not familiar with these tools – the Sovereign Blueprint provides a step-by-step guide to help you get started.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have your GitHub Pages site and Supabase project set up, you can configure your payment pipeline using Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments. This involves setting up a webhook to receive payment notifications and creating a delivery pipeline to instantly deliver products to customers. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a more comprehensive solution for this step, but with the Sovereign Blueprint, you can do it yourself for a fraction of the cost.
You own your infrastructure, and you control your digital store.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Testing before promotion is not optional — it is the step that determines whether your store functions correctly under real conditions before real buyers encounter it. The test sequence has four steps. First: deploy the backend and confirm the webhook endpoint returns a valid response to a test HTTP POST. Second: configure the storefront and confirm the checkout displays correctly on desktop and mobile. Third: complete a real mainnet transaction with a small amount of actual crypto. Fourth: check your order database and confirm the order was logged correctly, the delivery email arrived, and the download link works.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your digital store is live and processing transactions, you can start scaling your infrastructure to meet growing demand. This involves setting up load balancers, caching layers, and content delivery networks to ensure that your site remains fast and responsive even under heavy traffic. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a more comprehensive solution for this step, but with the Sovereign Blueprint, you can do it yourself for a fraction of the cost.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages? Yes, you can. In fact, GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages offer free hosting for static sites, making them an ideal choice for digital product stores. With the Sovereign Blueprint, you can deploy your digital store on either platform and start selling products instantly.
You can deploy your digital store in under 4 hours, following a step-by-step guide.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for a more comprehensive solution for your digital store, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which offers a more robust payment and delivery pipeline, as well as end-to-end testing and support. You can also check out our product lineup at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information on our digital store infrastructure solutions.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your digital store, follow these steps: set up a GitHub account and create a GitHub Pages site, generate a Supabase project and create a NOWPayments account, configure your payment pipeline using Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments, go live with your digital store and test your checkout flow, process your first transaction and verify that your products are being delivered correctly. For more information, check out the Sovereign Blueprint.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 is a more basic infrastructure stack that includes GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments, while Stack 02 is a more comprehensive solution that includes Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Stack 02 offers more features and support, but also comes at a higher cost.
Can I deploy my digital store in under 4 hours?
Yes, with the Sovereign Blueprint, you can deploy your digital store in under 4 hours, following a step-by-step guide that walks you through the process.
What is the cost of deploying my digital store?

The cost of deploying your digital store will depend on the infrastructure stack you choose. With the Sovereign Blueprint, you can deploy your digital store for a fraction of the cost of the Edge Commerce Stack ($197).
Do I need to have technical expertise to deploy my digital store?

No, you don't need to have technical expertise to deploy your digital store. The Sovereign Blueprint provides a step-by-step guide that walks you through the process, and our support team is available to help you troubleshoot any issues.
Can I use a different payment gateway than NOWPayments?

Yes, you can use a different payment gateway than NOWPayments. However, keep in mind that NOWPayments offers a more comprehensive solution for accepting crypto payments, and is specifically designed to work with the infrastructure stack provided by COREMERCH.
You can accept crypto payments and deliver products instantly, without relying on third-party platforms.
